# Smartling

> Smartling is a cloud-based translation management system (TMS) and language services provider that helps enterprises translate and localize websites, software, marketing content, and support content. The platform combines AI-powered translation, machine translation, and professional human linguists with automation, quality assurance, and analytics tools, and integrates with 50+ CMS, code, and marketing platforms.

Smartling serves enterprise localization, marketing, developer/product, and customer support teams across industries including eCommerce/retail, software, healthcare, and hospitality. Core differentiators: end-to-end automation (up to 99% of the translation process), AI translation backed by human linguist review, and enterprise-grade security/compliance (SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR, ISO 17100/9001/42001).

## Platform

- [Smartling homepage](https://www.smartling.com/): Entry point to the platform — AI translation paired with expert language services, with up to 100% automated workflows.
- [Translation Management System](https://www.smartling.com/translation-management-system): All-in-one translation orchestration platform — the core Smartling product.
- [Integrations](https://www.smartling.com/software): Connect Smartling to 50+ software platforms (CMSs, CRMs, code repos, marketing tools) to automate content flow.
- [Translation Proxy](https://www.smartling.com/website-translation-proxy): Web content translation without code changes, via Smartling's Global Delivery Network.
- [Analytics](https://www.smartling.com/software/translation-analytics/): Real-time dashboards on translation performance and spend.
- [Smartling Translate](https://www.smartling.com/software/smartling-translate/): AI-powered portal for instant, on-brand translations.
- [Translator Tools (CAT Tool)](https://www.smartling.com/software/cat-tool/): Cloud CAT tool for linguists with visual context, live translation memory, and quality checks.
- [LQA Agent](https://www.smartling.com/software/lqaagent): AI agent that evaluates translation quality at scale, instantly.
- [Quality](https://www.smartling.com/software/quality): Overview of how Smartling closes the gap between AI translation speed and quality.

## Translation & language services

- [Translation Services overview](https://www.smartling.com/translation-services/): Machine Translation, AI Translation, AI Human Translation, and Creative Translation tiers, with published per-word pricing.
- [AI Translation](https://www.smartling.com/software/ai-translation-solutions): AI Translation and AI Human Translation options for human-quality output at AI speed.
- [AI Hub](https://www.smartling.com/ai-hub): Translate using 20+ LLMs and machine translation engines in one place.
- [Professional Translation](https://www.smartling.com/professional-translation): Human translation delivered by a vetted network of native-speaking professional linguists.

## Solutions by use case, industry, and team

- [Why Smartling](https://www.smartling.com/why-smartling): Overview of why enterprises choose Smartling across use cases.
- [Website Translation](https://www.smartling.com/use-case/website-translation/): Localize websites and keep translated content in sync as pages change.
- [Software & Mobile Apps Translation](https://www.smartling.com/use-case/web-and-mobile-apps-translation/): Translate product/UI strings without slowing development.
- [Marketing Content](https://www.smartling.com/teams/marketing): Translate campaigns and marketing assets while preserving brand voice.
- [Customer Support / Help Center](https://www.smartling.com/teams/customer-support/): Translate help articles and FAQs for global customers.
- [eCommerce/Retail](https://www.smartling.com/industry/retail): Localization for retail and eCommerce brands.
- [Technology (Software companies)](https://www.smartling.com/industry/technology): Localization for software and mobile app companies.
- [Healthcare](https://www.smartling.com/industries/healthcare/): Compliant, accurate localization for healthcare content.
- [Learning & Development / eLearning](https://www.smartling.com/industry/elearning): Localize training courses, onboarding, and internal L&D content.
- [Automotive](https://www.smartling.com/industry/automotive): Localization for automotive brands reaching global car buyers.
- [Insurance](https://www.smartling.com/industry/insurance): Secure, compliant translation for insurance policies and claims documents.
- [Legal](https://www.smartling.com/industry/legal): Confidential, consistent translation for contracts, court transcripts, and other legal documents.
- [Managed Care](https://www.smartling.com/industry/managed-care): Compliant translation for health plans and managed care organizations.
- [Pharmaceutical & Clinical Research](https://www.smartling.com/industry/pharmaceuticals): Specialized translation for pharmaceutical and clinical research content.
- [Technical Content](https://www.smartling.com/use-case/technical-translation/): Translation for technical documentation, combining AI with native-speaking linguists.
- [Developer & Product Teams](https://www.smartling.com/teams/developer): Translation workflows built for development speed — open API, CLI and SDKs, webhooks, CI/CD, MCP server, and 50+ connectors.
- [Product Teams](https://www.smartling.com/teams/product): Localization built into the product development lifecycle and tool stack.
- [Localization Teams](https://www.smartling.com/teams/localization/): Tools for localization program managers to scale globally.
- [Browse all use cases](https://www.smartling.com/use-cases): Full index of Smartling use cases by team, industry, and use case.

## How Smartling compares

- [Smartling vs. competitors (hub)](https://www.smartling.com/compare/): Overview page comparing Smartling to other translation management platforms.
- [Smartling vs. Crowdin](https://www.smartling.com/compare/crowdin)
- [Smartling vs. Lilt](https://www.smartling.com/compare/lilt)
- [Smartling vs. Lokalise](https://www.smartling.com/compare/lokalise)
- [Smartling vs. Phrase](https://www.smartling.com/compare/phrase)
- [Smartling vs. TransPerfect](https://www.smartling.com/compare/transperfect)
- [Smartling vs. XTM International](https://www.smartling.com/compare/xtm-international)

## Pricing

- [Plans](https://www.smartling.com/plans): Core and Enterprise pricing tiers and what's included at each level.

## Resources

- [AI Localization Hub](https://www.smartling.com/resources/ai-localization-hub): Answers on AI translation quality, security, governance, and cost.
- [Success Stories / Case Studies](https://www.smartling.com/resources/case-study): Customer stories on results achieved with Smartling.
- [Resource Center](https://www.smartling.com/ebooks): Guides, whitepapers, and tools for localization programs.
- [Blog](https://www.smartling.com/blog): Tips, trends, and insights on localization and translation.
- [Webinars](https://www.smartling.com/webinars): On-demand webinars, panels, and fireside chats.
- [Events](https://www.smartling.com/globalready/): Upcoming webinars, conferences, and industry events.
- [Global Ready Conference](https://www.smartling.com/conference): Smartling's conference for localization leaders; 2026 sessions are available on demand.
- [Forrester Wave: Localization Services, Q3 2026](https://www.smartling.com/ebooks/forrester-wave-localization-services): Forrester's evaluation of 11 localization services providers across 27 criteria, in which Smartling was named a Leader.
- [Best Translation Management Software](https://www.smartling.com/best-translation-management-software): Reviews and comparisons to help buyers choose a TMS.
- [Help Center](https://help.smartling.com/hc/en-us): Product documentation, walkthroughs, and support articles.

## Trust & security

- [Security](https://www.smartling.com/security): Overview of Smartling's certifications — SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR, HITRUST, and ISO standards (including ISO/IEC 42001 for AI management).
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.smartling.com/privacy/): How Smartling handles personal data.
- [Accessibility](https://www.smartling.com/accessibility): Smartling's accessibility commitments.
- [Sample Translation RFP](https://www.smartling.com/sample-translation-rfp/): Template for issuing a translation services RFP.

## Company

- [About Us](https://www.smartling.com/about-us/): Smartling's mission, values, and global impact.
- [News](https://www.smartling.com/company-news): Company updates, product launches, and milestones.
- [Careers](https://www.smartling.com/careers/): Life and culture at Smartling, with a link out to current global openings.
- [Partners](https://www.smartling.com/partner-ecosystem/): Smartling's partner network and collaboration opportunities.
- [Contact Us](https://www.smartling.com/contact-us/): Get in touch with the Smartling team.
- [Translator Information](https://www.smartling.com/translator_information): Information for linguists applying to Smartling's translator network.

## Optional

- [Status](https://status.smartling.com/): Live platform status and uptime.
- [Legal](https://www.smartling.com/legal/): Terms and legal agreements.
- [Excellence at Every Touchpoint](https://www.smartling.com/excellence-every-touchpoint/): Smartling's approach to customer experience.

  /* MEGA MENU FIX 2026-10-06: the four .mega-menu-N panels are rendered at the
     bottom of <header> and used to be moved into their menu <li> only on
     window "load", which waits for every image and third-party script. Until
     then a hover showed the panel positioned against the header (top:51px of

  (function() {
    var base = ".header-section .bottom-part .right-part .mainmenu .hs-menu-wrapper>ul>";
    $(base + "li:first-child").append($(".mega-menu-1"));
    $(base + "li:nth-child(2)").append($(".mega-menu-2"));
    $(base + "li:nth-child(4)").append($(".mega-menu-3"));
    $(base + "li:nth-child(5)").append($(".mega-menu-4"));
    $('.mega-menu-1, .mega-menu-2, .mega-menu-3, .mega-menu-4').attr('aria-hidden', 'true');
    $(base + "li:first-child > a, " +
      base + "li:nth-child(2) > a, " +
      base + "li:nth-child(4) > a, " +
      base + "li:nth-child(5) > a").attr('aria-expanded', 'false');
  })();

  $(document).ready(function() {
    var windowWidth = $(window).width();
    if (windowWidth > 991) {
      equalheight('.megaa .shh');
    }

    var $nav = $(".mainmenu .hs-menu-wrapper");
    $nav.find("ul[role='menu']").removeAttr("role");
    $nav.find("li[role='none']").removeAttr("role");
    $nav.find("a[role='menuitem']").removeAttr("role");
    if ($nav.closest("nav").length === 0) {
      $nav.wrap('<nav aria-label="Main navigation"></nav>');
    }

    $(".eyebrow-inner .language").click(function() {
      $(".eyebrow-inner .language .language_selector").toggle();
    });

    if ($(window).width() > 991) {

      function showMega($menu) {
        $menu.css("visibility", "visible").attr("aria-hidden", "false");
        $menu.prev("a").attr("aria-expanded", "true");
      }

      function hideMega($menu) {
        $menu.css("visibility", "hidden").attr("aria-hidden", "true");
        $menu.prev("a").attr("aria-expanded", "false");
      }

      var menuMap = [
        { selector: "li:first-child", menu: ".mega-menu-1" },
        { selector: "li:nth-child(2)", menu: ".mega-menu-2" },
        { selector: "li:nth-child(4)", menu: ".mega-menu-3" },
        { selector: "li:nth-child(5)", menu: ".mega-menu-4" }
      ];

      var base = ".header-section .bottom-part .right-part .mainmenu .hs-menu-wrapper>ul>";

      $.each(menuMap, function(i, item) {
        $(base + item.selector).hover(
          function() { showMega($(item.menu)); },
          function() { hideMega($(item.menu)); }
        );
      });

    } else {

      // Mobile: menus start collapsed — no upfront .hide() so slideToggle works correctly
      $('.megaa').hide().attr("aria-hidden", "true");

      $('.header-section .bottom-part .right-part .mainmenu .hs-menu-wrapper>ul>li a')
        .removeClass('active')
        .attr('aria-expanded', 'false');

      $(".header-section .bottom-part .right-part .mainmenu .hs-menu-wrapper>ul>li a")
        .click(function() {
          var $this = $(this);
          var $allLinks = $('.header-section .bottom-part .right-part .mainmenu .hs-menu-wrapper>ul>li a');
          var $allMenus = $('.megaa');

          $allLinks.not($this).removeClass('active').attr('aria-expanded', 'false');
          $allMenus.not($this.next()).slideUp(function() {
            $(this).attr('aria-hidden', 'true');
          });

          $this.toggleClass('active');
          var isExpanded = $this.hasClass('active');
          $this.attr('aria-expanded', String(isExpanded));
          $this.next().slideToggle(250, function() {
            $(this).attr('aria-hidden', String(!isExpanded));
          });
        });
    }

    function maxheight(clsaaName) {

      });
      $(clsaaName).css('height', hi);
    }
  });

<script>
  /* MEGA MENU FIX 2026-10-06: the four .mega-menu-N panels are rendered at the
     bottom of <header> and used to be moved into their menu <li> only on
     window "load", which waits for every image and third-party script. Until
     then a hover showed the panel positioned against the header (top:51px of
     the header, hidden behind it) - the "broken mega menu on page load".
     The markup already exists when this script runs, so move them right away.
     REVERT: restore the $(window).on('load') block that did the same append. */
  (function() {
    var base = ".header-section .bottom-part .right-part .mainmenu .hs-menu-wrapper>ul>";
    $(base + "li:first-child").append($(".mega-menu-1"));
    $(base + "li:nth-child(2)").append($(".mega-menu-2"));
    $(base + "li:nth-child(4)").append($(".mega-menu-3"));
    $(base + "li:nth-child(5)").append($(".mega-menu-4"));
    $('.mega-menu-1, .mega-menu-2, .mega-menu-3, .mega-menu-4').attr('aria-hidden', 'true');
    $(base + "li:first-child > a, " +
      base + "li:nth-child(2) > a, " +
      base + "li:nth-child(4) > a, " +
      base + "li:nth-child(5) > a").attr('aria-expanded', 'false');
  })();

  $(document).ready(function() {
    var windowWidth = $(window).width();
    if (windowWidth > 991) {
      equalheight('.megaa .shh');
    }

    var $nav = $(".mainmenu .hs-menu-wrapper");
    $nav.find("ul[role='menu']").removeAttr("role");
    $nav.find("li[role='none']").removeAttr("role");
    $nav.find("a[role='menuitem']").removeAttr("role");
    if ($nav.closest("nav").length === 0) {
      $nav.wrap('<nav aria-label="Main navigation"></nav>');
    }

    $(".eyebrow-inner .language").click(function() {
      $(".eyebrow-inner .language .language_selector").toggle();
    });

    if ($(window).width() > 991) {

      function showMega($menu) {
        $menu.css("visibility", "visible").attr("aria-hidden", "false");
        $menu.prev("a").attr("aria-expanded", "true");
      }

      function hideMega($menu) {
        $menu.css("visibility", "hidden").attr("aria-hidden", "true");
        $menu.prev("a").attr("aria-expanded", "false");
      }

      var menuMap = [
        { selector: "li:first-child", menu: ".mega-menu-1" },
        { selector: "li:nth-child(2)", menu: ".mega-menu-2" },
        { selector: "li:nth-child(4)", menu: ".mega-menu-3" },
        { selector: "li:nth-child(5)", menu: ".mega-menu-4" }
      ];

      var base = ".header-section .bottom-part .right-part .mainmenu .hs-menu-wrapper>ul>";

      $.each(menuMap, function(i, item) {
        $(base + item.selector).hover(
          function() { showMega($(item.menu)); },
          function() { hideMega($(item.menu)); }
        );
      });

    } else {

      // Mobile: menus start collapsed — no upfront .hide() so slideToggle works correctly
      $('.megaa').hide().attr("aria-hidden", "true");

      $('.header-section .bottom-part .right-part .mainmenu .hs-menu-wrapper>ul>li a')

        .click(function() {
          var $this = $(this);
          var $allLinks = $('.header-section .bottom-part .right-part .mainmenu .hs-menu-wrapper>ul>li a');
          var $allMenus = $('.megaa');

          $allLinks.not($this).removeClass('active').attr('aria-expanded', 'false');
          $allMenus.not($this.next()).slideUp(function() {
            $(this).attr('aria-hidden', 'true');
          });

          $this.toggleClass('active');
          var isExpanded = $this.hasClass('active');
          $this.attr('aria-expanded', String(isExpanded));
          $this.next().slideToggle(250, function() {
            $(this).attr('aria-hidden', String(!isExpanded));
          });
        });
    }

    function maxheight(clsaaName) {

      var hi = 0;
      $(clsaaName).each(function() {
        var h = $(this).outerHeight();
        if (h > hi) { hi = h; highest = $(this); }
      });
      $(clsaaName).css('height', hi);
    }
  });

  (function() {
    var base = ".header-section .bottom-part .right-part .mainmenu .hs-menu-wrapper>ul>";

  $(document).ready(function() {
    var windowWidth = $(window).width();

    $nav.find("ul[role='menu']").removeAttr("role");

      function hideMega($menu) {
        $menu.css("visibility", "hidden").attr("aria-hidden", "true");
        $menu.prev("a").attr("aria-expanded", "false");
      }

      var menuMap = [
        { selector: "li:first-child", menu: ".mega-menu-1" },
        { selector: "li:nth-child(2)", menu: ".mega-menu-2" },
        { selector: "li:nth-child(4)", menu: ".mega-menu-3" },

      var base = ".header-section .bottom-part .right-part .mainmenu .hs-menu-wrapper>ul>";

          $this.attr('aria-expanded', String(isExpanded));
          $this.next().slideToggle(250, function() {
            $(this).attr('aria-hidden', String(!isExpanded));

     Hides every HubSpot pop-up/slide-in/banner CTA after 80px of scroll, and makes any hidden
     CTA unclickable (HubSpot's own "loaded" class forces visibility:visible + pointer-events:auto
     with !important, so an inline hide left an invisible box that still caught clicks).
     REVERT: restore the previous Site footer HTML from localStorage on app.hubspot.com,
     key ctafix_backup_footer_2026-11-12. -->
<style>
html .sm-cta-scroll-hidden, html .sm-cta-scroll-hidden *{visibility:hidden!important;opacity:0!important;pointer-events:none!important;transition:opacity .3s ease,visibility 0s linear .3s!important}
html .sm-cta-click-off, html .sm-cta-click-off *{pointer-events:none!important}
</style>
<script>
(function () {
  if (window.__smCtaFix) return; window.__smCtaFix = 1;
  var POP = '[id^="hs-overlay-cta-"],[id^="hs-banner-cta-"]';
  var ANY = POP + ',#hs-web-interactives-top-anchor > *,#hs-web-interactives-bottom-anchor > *,.hs-cta-embed__loaded';
  function each(s, f) { var n = document.querySelectorAll(s); for (var i = 0; i < n.length; i++) f(n[i]); }
  /* 1. scroll hide: all pop-up CTAs, not just the first one */
  function scrollHide() {
    var hide = window.scrollY > 80;
    each(POP, function (el) { el.classList.toggle('sm-cta-scroll-hidden', hide); });
  }
  /* 2. guard: any CTA that is invisible for ANY reason can never catch clicks */
  function guard() {
    each(ANY, function (el) {
      var cs = getComputedStyle(el);
      var off = cs.display === 'none' || cs.visibility === 'hidden' || parseFloat(cs.opacity) < 0.05;
      el.classList.toggle('sm-cta-click-off', off);
    });
  }
  var t, raf;
  function later() { clearTimeout(t); t = setTimeout(guard, 50); setTimeout(guard, 400); }
  function run() { if (raf) return; raf = requestAnimationFrame(function () { raf = 0; scrollHide(); later(); }); }
  function start() {
    run();
    new MutationObserver(run).observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['style', 'class'] });
    document.addEventListener('transitionend', later, true);
    window.addEventListener('scroll', run, { passive: true });
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', start); else start();
})();
</script>
